# Symbolab

> > Symbolab is a comprehensive math calculator and equation solver providing step-by-step solutions for algebra, calculus, and pre-algebra problems.

Symbolab offers free online calculators and solvers for students and educators, covering linear equations, quadratic equations, rational equations, fractions, statistics, and more. The platform specializes in showing detailed step-by-step solutions to help users understand mathematical concepts and problem-solving methods.

## Key Topics

- step-by-step solutions
- algebra solver
- equation solving
- linear equations
- quadratic equations
- rational equations
- fractions calculator
- mixed numbers
- polynomial roots
- pre-algebra
- arithmetic operations
- ratio and proportion
- statistics mode
- decimal conversion

## Core Calculators

- [Linear Equation Calculator](https://www.symbolab.com/solver/linear-equation-calculator): Free linear equation calculator with step-by-step algebra solutions
- [Mixed Fractions Calculator - No Signup Needed](https://www.symbolab.com/solver/mixed-fractions-calculator): Free mixed numbers calculator for add/subtract/multiply/divide operations
- [Equivalent Fractions Calculator](https://www.symbolab.com/solver/equivalent-fractions-calculator): Free equivalent fractions calculator to find fraction equivalences
- [Unit Rate Calculator](https://www.symbolab.com/solver/unit-rate-calculator): Free unit rate calculator for ratios, fractions, and proportions
- [One-Step Addition Equation Calculator](https://www.symbolab.com/solver/one-step-addition-equation-calculator): Free one-step addition equation solver for basic algebra education
